properties.evidence: Opposing on scope, not on intent. That capability's own description claims exactly this case — 'use when you catch yourself keeping a to-do list in the conversation' — so on paper the ground is taken. In practice the skill is 106 lines, 12 steps, and reaches add_epoch / add_release / gate_on / arrival_delta / detect_gaps / loop_status plus TRL thresholds. Either the claim in its description is too wide, or a fast path is owed; both cannot stand as they are, and the design will have to pick.
